end.summary:
Asha practised identifying equal parts and naming halves, thirds and quarters.
Nisha gave some correct answers, but this was not steady yet and needs checking next time.
Asha practised comparing 1/2, 1/3 and 1/4 of the same whole; this also needs further checking.
Nisha mixed up parts left with parts in the whole; Asha corrected this during the lesson, but the confusion appeared again later.
end.parentNote: Nisha practised naming fractions by checking whether the parts are equal and comparing the size of one part when a whole is divided into 2, 3 or 4 equal parts. Using equal-share examples helped correct the mix-up between “one part out of the whole” and “one part out of the parts left,” though this needs revisiting. At home, share a roti or draw circles divided into 2, 3 and 4 equal parts, then ask: “What fraction is one part of the whole?”
